metadata.name: 16x32_pixel_oak_tree_sprite
metadata.description: 16x32 pixel oak tree sprite in Stardew Valley style. Basic deciduous tree with rounded green canopy (#228B22) and brown trunk (#8B4513). Top-down orthographic perspective with slight front angle. Canopy occupies upper portion, trunk visible at bottom. Footprint is 12x8 pixels at trunk base. Tree extends upward from ground position. Clean pixel art with black outline, natural organic shape.
